notes.title: Here are the 5 skillful contest winners!
notes.content:
As a special Next Fest event, we had a contest running from 10/14/24 to 10/21/24 where the highest scoring players could get their hands on my previous game, Fremdganger - The Cheating Demon. Now that the event is finished, I am happy to announce the winners:

[h3]Score | Name[/h3]
[b]38 [/b] -   Selina13
[b]9 [/b]  -    LifeCereal
[b]7 [/b]  -    Rob_Boss
[b]5 [/b]  -    Manouche
[b]5 [/b]  -    Frostly

Please reach out to me via email ( mastermind680@gmail.com ) and send me a link to your Steam account to claim your prize! Alternatively, you can also just comment under this event if you are one of the five winners and I will reach out to you myself.

I hope you will continue to have fun with this game and are looking forward to the full release!

notes.title: CONTEST: Win 5 copies of Fremdganger - The Cheating Demon
notes.content:
Hello!
I hope you're having fun with my Demo. If you are, you can now put your skills to good use and win my previous game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2307630/Fremdganger__The_Cheating_Demon/]Fremdganger - The Cheating Demon[/url]!


[h3]How does it work?[/h3]

Jump into "Endless Mode" and try to come as far as possible. When you fail, you will be able to submit your score to a leaderboard (please use your Steam username as your name so no one else can claim to have achieved your score). The 5 highest scores that get logged during the duration of Steam Next Fest (10/14/2024 - 10/21/2024) will get a free copy of Fremdganger.
Do not worry about these super high scores that are already here, they were achieved before today and don't count towards the giveaway:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032798/90c5cb95eca238d1a2049971c7d183315d614ca6.png[/img]


[h3]How can I achieve a higher score?[/h3]

If you haven't beat Main Mode yet, do that before tackling Endless Mode. Upgrade and copy your strongest cards, and get as many cards/artifacts as possible. Don't underestimate gold as a resource!

The winners will be publicly announced shortly after Next Fest ends. Good luck!
